# Real COWBOYS checkpoint fixture

The four `cowboys_albuterol_similarity_1*` files are byte-for-byte copies from
`results/cowboys/verification_script_pcn_20261117T090734/`, the existing CPU
verification run of 2026-11-17 (10 initial molecules, one completed BO step).
They were not generated by a test or rescored. The status intentionally lacks
planned budget, physical-call flags, oracle version and timings. Tests provide
the known one-step budget explicitly and preserve these missing fields.

The checkpoint path inside solver configuration is recorded historical metadata;
tests/export never open or load that model. The ranked candidate diagnostics are
not additional oracle observations. Fixture hashes are checked against the
exported provenance and original bytes remain unchanged after export.
